name: cavemio-buy-box
title: Buy box
description: A product buy box whose swatches repaint the product: pick a colour and size, and Add to bag throws the product into the bag.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Each option is a radio group named by its label; swatches are named by their colour, and values that aren’t made or are sold out say so.
- Adding and restock notes are announced from a status region; the bag’s count is in its label.
- The flying product is a copy laid over the block and removed when it lands; nothing moves under focus.
- The stage’s colour is your product’s (the swatch), lit from its corner with 1px edges; everything else uses your theme, in light and dark. No drop shadows, glow or blur.
- Built from Input, Stepper input, Number roll, Status button and Text morph, which the CLI installs with it. No animation library; with reduced motion the stage changes colour in place and nothing flies.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: options
props.description: – · { id, label, values: { id, label, swatch? }[] }. A value with swatch (any CSS colour) is a swatch and paints the stage.

props.name: variants
props.description: – · { id, options: { [optionId]: valueId }, price, compareAt?, stock?, image? }. stock 0 is sold out; leave it out for plenty.

props.name: onAddToCart
props.description: – · Add to the bag; throw an Error to show why not.

props.name: onNotify
props.description: – · Shows Notify me on sold-out variants and keeps the address.

props.name: name / brand
props.description: – · The product, and a line above it.

props.name: icon
props.description: – · The product’s glyph on the stage when a variant has no image.

props.name: defaultSelection
props.description: first in stock · The picks it opens with.

props.name: bagCount / lowStockAt
props.description: 0 / 5 · What’s in the bag already, and where “Only N left” starts.

useCases.title: Product pages
useCases.description: The buy box beside the photos on a store’s product page.

useCases.title: Quick view
useCases.description: Choosing a variant from a collection grid without leaving it.

useCases.title: Landing page drops
useCases.description: A single product sold straight from its launch page.

useCases.title: Merch stores

features.title: Variants worked out for you
features.description: Pick a colour and only sizes made in it stay live; a pick that isn’t made moves the others to the nearest variant that is.

features.title: The product in its colour
features.description: Swatches paint the stage, or a variant’s image takes its place, so the choice shows before the name does.

features.title: Price and stock that keep up
features.description: Prices roll, sales show their saving, and stock reads In stock, Only 2 left or Sold out.

features.title: Added, visibly
features.description: onAddToCart goes Adding → Added, the product flies into the bag and the count rolls.

features.title: Back-in-stock in place
features.description: Sold out turns the button into Notify me with an email field; onNotify keeps the address.

features.title: Your catalogue, plain data
features.description: Options, values with swatches and variants with price, compareAt and stock: no product schema to adopt.

states.title: pick
states.description: The stage in the picked colour with the product on engraved rings, the bag in the corner, name and price, swatches, sizes, stock and a stepper beside Add to bag.

states.title: colour
states.description: A new swatch floods the stage colour (520ms) and the rings ripple from 0.9× (620ms, a slight overshoot); the swatch’s ring is thrown to it and the label morphs.

states.title: not made / sold out
states.description: Values not made with the current picks, or sold out, are dimmed and struck through, and say so to screen readers.

states.title: price
states.description: The price rolls between variants; a sale shows the old price struck through and a −25% badge on the stage.

states.title: add
states.description: Add to bag → Adding → Added; a copy of the product arcs into the bag (680ms) and the bag bumps as its count rolls.

states.title: notify
states.description: Sold out shows Notify me; pressing it turns the row into an email field and Notify me, which goes Saving → You’re on the list.

states.title: error
states.description: If onAddToCart throws, the button shakes into Try again and the message shows under it.
